data.name: Indiscriminate
data.description: Whenever the order of the asp cavalier uses Intimidate to demoralize one or more creatures, she can attempt to demoralize an equal number of allies within 30 feet as a free action. While within 30 feet of an ally with the shaken condition, the cavalier gains a +%1 morale bonus on saving throws. The cavalier can perform a dirty trick combat maneuver against creatures with the shaken condition without provoking an attack of opportunity.|AspOrderIndiscriminateBonus
